name: SimCoaster/TPI - New Worlds, Rides and Sprites
author: TPW Decomp
summary: Three SimCoaster worlds, from your own copy of that game.
text: Adds three worlds made from your own copy of SimCoaster (AKA Theme Park Inc, 2001), the game's sequel: Arabian Nights, Polar Zone and Land of Invention, each with its own rides, shops, sideshows and scenery, played by Theme Park World's rules on a second group of islands. It stays locked until that game's worlds are in the data folder. A park in one of them needs them to load.
